note.en: Analytic reference Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization uses an eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts. L-BFGS retains only the current last three pairs. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.
